Behavioral Economics</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set the global roadmap for compensation experimentation: A/B testing across offer types, value levels, channel timing, and segmentation variables.</li> <li>Apply behavioral economics frameworks to compensation design understanding how recovery offers shape long-term retention, repurchase behavior, and brand perception, not just immediate satisfaction.</li> <li>Define the measurement framework for experimentation: what constitutes a successful test, what confidence warrants global rollout, and how results are synthesized into durable policy change.</li> <li>Partner with Analytics &amp; Insights to ensure test design, sample integrity, and rollout analysis meet a rigorous standard of evidence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Stewardship &amp; Cost Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the global compensation P&amp;L line: tracking spend by market, error category, customer segment, and channel — and holding yourself accountable to defined cost-per-incident and avoidable-contact targets.</li> <li>Identify and close financial leakage: cases where compensation is being issued without policy justification, at incorrect values, or at the wrong frequency.</li> <li>Build the reporting infrastructure that makes compensation economics visible to GCX leadership, market GMs, and Finance — with the granularity and context needed to drive decisions.</li> <li>Define the right balance between cost optimization and customer lifetime value investment: not just 'spend less' but 'spend where it earns back.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Fraud Policy &amp; Global Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the global fraud and abuse prevention framework: the policies, detection logic, thresholds, and escalation paths that protect the business without creating friction for genuine customers.</li> <li>Lead the governance rhythm for policy: quarterly reviews, market exception management, escalation adjudication, and framework versioning across a multi-brand, multi-market environment.</li> <li>Act as the final authority on complex, cross-market policy gaps — resolving ambiguity with speed, consistency, and strategic clarity rather than routing decisions upward by default.</li> <li>Maintain global standards while creating principled space for market-level adaptation where local context genuinely requires it.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership &amp; Stakeholder Accountability</strong></p> <ul> <li>Represent the compensation function in senior forums translating customer economics into requirements that peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market GMs must respond to.</li> <li>Hold cross-functional partners accountable for the upstream data quality, operational accuracy, and system reliability that the compensation engine depends on.</li> <li>Drive adoption of policy changes across markets and brands, building communication and change management plans that make new frameworks land — not just launch.</li> <li>Influence at VP and Director level across multiple functions; title: Senior Staff Communication Systems Engineer
description: At  CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. We are looking to add a  Senior Staff Communication Systems Engineer to our team in Munich Germany. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge phased array antennas and radios for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in systems engineering, experience in space technology, and the ability to be the technical point of contact for our communication programs. In this position, you will lead the development of space architecture concepts, sub-system design, payload design, requirements development, analysis and decomposition, high-level software and hardware system architecture design, concept of operations (CONOPS) development, and risk assessment. You will coordinate activities across multidisciplinary engineering teams, raise issues at the program level, and drive complex programs to success. The successful candidate will communicate effectively with team members and internal stakeholders, both verbally and through written content. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Evaluate customer and operational needs to define requirements, integrate technical parameters, and assure compatibility of all physical, functional, and program interfaces. Represent CesiumAstro in customer meetings, design reviews, and technical discussions across Europe. Define and validate space system requirements and interfaces, ensuring end-to-end feasibility. Develop and direct technical concept development in support of proposals and demonstrations. Participate in developing system engineering processes for requirements management, flow-down, and traceability. Lead system-level trade studies, including antenna architecture design, modem design, performance analysis and system level integration. Coordinate with RF/Antenna, Electrical, and Software/FPGA engineers to ensure concept feasibility and compliance. Support proposal development, design reviews, and technical documentation. JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS M.S. or higher in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field. 12+ years of experience in system engineering for communications payloads, RF systems, or space/defense platforms. Very strong background in communication theory. Practical experience working with antenna systems (design, integration, or performance evaluation). Experience with and understanding of satellite-communications standards (e.g., NR NTN, DVB-S2x, CCSDS). Proven ability to capture and manage requirements across multidisciplinary teams. Excellent communication skills; comfortable presenting to customers and leading design reviews. Fluent in English (German language skills a plus). Deep understanding of RF concepts, impairments, and their impacts on system performance. WHAT WE OFFER The opportunity to help establish CesiumAstro’s first European office and grow our Munich team. High-impact role with direct exposure to leading EU space programs. Competitive compensation and benefits package. A collaborative, innovative environment shaping the future of space communications. CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. Please be aware that many roles will be subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors including new starter’s nationality, any previous or dual nationalities held, place of birth and country of residence may limit those roles that you can perform for the organization. Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Du führst regelmäßige Architektur- und Code-Reviews durch, um die Einhaltung von Standards, Wartbarkeit und Security-Richtlinien zu gewährleisten. title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer / SRE – Kubernetes & Hybrid Cloud (m/f/d)
description: Introduction At a glance Location &workmodel:Berlin, hybrid Tech stack:Kubernetes on our own servers, Harvester (KubeVirt), Argo CD/Flux, Prometheus/Grafana, Longhorn/Ceph Team:A growing SRE team – you report to our CTPO for now and to the Team Lead SREwe'rehiring next; two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware Process:Intro call · take-home task (~2h) · 90-min tech interview with our developers · leadership conversation · meet the team Languages:Fluent Englishrequired; German is a plus, nota must Why this role is special Most SRE jobs today mean clicking around a managed cloud console. This one doesn't. We run our own hardware in Frankfurt and are building a modern private cloud platform on Kubernetes and Harvester – on-prem by default, with elastic burst into the public cloud and the option to go cloud-only later. You won't inherit a finished SRE practice: you'll help define it, side by side with our Berlin development teams – and you won't do it alone, a Team Lead SRE hire is coming next. SRE here is an enabling discipline: you build what our developers need to ship reliably, while two system administrators in Pforzheim run the physical hardware. And the impact is direct – our product discovery technology powers more than 2,000 European online shops (Intersport, SPAR, Douglas and more), handling billions of shopper queries a year. When product discovery is slow or down, our customers lose revenue in real time. Your first 90 days You get to know both products, join the on-call rotation with a buddy, and own your first reliability topic – SLOs for one product, alerting that actually helps at 3 a.m., or automating away a piece of toil. Before you decide, ask us to put you on a call with someone who will tell you the good, the bad and the ugly.

To apply: skip the cover letter. Tell us about a model you built that made it into production, and one modeling decision in it you would reverse today.

title: Senior Manager Recruiting & Employer Branding (m/f/d)
description: Intro Willkommen bei Sanoptis – einem führenden Netzwerk moderner Augenkliniken und augenärztlicher Praxen mit über 480 Standorten in ganz Europa. Unsere Vision ist es, Wohlbefinden und Lebensqualität durch erstklassige augenärztliche Behandlung zu verbessern. Unser innovatives, dezentrales Modell ermöglicht es unseren Partnerstandorten, unabhängig zu operieren und sich auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse ihrer Patienten zu konzentrieren. Gleichzeitig sind sie Teil eines größeren Netzwerks mit starken Partnern, das ihnen Synergieeffekte, modernste Technik und viele weitere Vorteile bietet. Du bist ein Talent-Experte und weißt, wie eine Arbeitgebermarke repräsentativ zu etablieren ist und die besten Talente zu gewinnen sind? In unserem People-Team bist Du für den gesamten Rekrutierungsprozess der Sanoptis-Gruppe verantwortlich. Du steuerst die Besetzung unserer offenen Stellen in 6 europäischen Ländern (DACH, Spanien, Italien, Griechenland). Du entwickelst und etablierst Best Practices, um die Standardisierung zu erhöhen und Synergien innerhalb unseres Netzwerks zu nutzen. Gemeinsam mit uns etablierst Du Sanoptis als den Employer-of-Choice am Markt. Die Position ist zunächst als Elternzeitvertretung auf 18 Monate befristet. In dieser Rolle wirst Du Unsere Recruiting-Prozesse entwerfen und steuern : Du trägst die Verantwortung für alle Rekrutierungsaktivitäten der Sanoptis-Gruppe, einschließlich Stellenbeschreibungen, Kanalplanung, Active Sourcing, Bewerberauswahl und Durchführung von Erstgesprächen. Unsere Metriken im Blick behalten und auswerten : Du wirst unsere KPI-Dashboards zur Überwachung der Leistung von Rekrutierungsaktivitäten steuern, auswerten und daraus Daten und evidenzbasierte Handlungen ableiten. Unsere Recruitment-Partner intern und extern steuern : Du wirst Partner wie Stellenportale, Headhunter oder Personalagenturen steuern, Verträge prüfen und Preise verhandeln, um uns stets den besten Zugang zu Talenten zu sichern. Dabei steuerst Du auch Rekrutierungskampagnen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Marketingteam. Zusätzlich schulst Du die Personalverantwortlichen der Kliniken zur Verbesserung ihrer Recruitingaktivitäten. Recruiting mit KI weiterentwickeln : Du beobachtest relevante KI-Trends und nutzt Claude gezielt, um Recruiting-Prozesse zu automatisieren und zu optimieren sowie KI-basierte Projekte eigenständig voranzutreiben. Unsere Employer-Brand-Strategie umsetzen : Du stärkst die Sanoptis Employer Brand und entwickelst unsere Außenauftrittem, insbesondere auf LinkedIn, kununu und weiteren relevanten Plattformen, kontinuierlich weiter. Du wirst zusammenarbeiten mit Der Head of People Angelina Budes als Deine Führungskraft. Dem globalen People-Team, welches in Recruiting, L&D und People Business Partnering unterteilt ist. Entscheidungsträgern wie Head-ofs, C-Level Executives und Hiring Managern, wenn es um die Einstellung der besten Talente geht. Vielen weiteren Stakeholdern im gesamten Unternehmen durch Hiring-Prozesse, Trainings und weitere Recruiting-Maßnahmen, die Du leitest. Dein Profil überzeugt durch Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Recruiting oder Personalwesen. Erfahrung im internationalen Stakeholder-Management. Idealerweise hast Du bereits in einem Private-Equity-Umfeld gearbeitet. Affinität zu KI-Anwendungen , insbesondere Claude; praktische Erfahrung mit KI-gestützten Recruiting-Prozessen und -Projekten ist ein Plus. Erfahrung mit ATS-Systemen (z.B. Personio). Ausgeprägte analytische, konzeptionelle und strategische Fähigkeiten und idealerweise Erfahrung im Projektmanagement. Emotionale Intelligenz sowie hervorragende zwischenmenschliche und kommunikative Fähigkeiten. Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau . Sanoptis bietet Dir Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung : Ein äußerst wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket, ergänzt durch einen jährlichen leistungsabhängigen Bonus, der an individuelle und unternehmensspezifische Ziele gebunden ist. Eigenständigkeit und kreative Freiheit: Die Möglichkeit, selbstständig zu arbeiten und sich mit innovativen Ideen einzubringen, dank flacher Hierarchien und kurzer Entscheidungswege, was unsere Organisation stärkt. Berufliche Entwicklung: Nutze die Möglichkeiten für kontinuierliches Lernen und Wachstum durch Schulungen, Online-Akademien, Workshops und Branchenkonferenzen. Inklusive Kultur: Arbeite in einem talentierten und vielfältigen Team mit einer herzlichen Bürokultur und Teamveranstaltungen. Mitarbeiterrabatte: Vergünstigte Konditionen auf zahlreiche ausgewählte Markenprodukte und Dienstleistungen über unseren Partner Corporate Benefits. Flexible steuerfreie Benefits : Ein individuelles Benefit-Budget von monatlich 50 €, welches nach persönlichen Bedürfnissen gestaltet und steuerfrei genutzt werden kann. Gleiche Chancen Bei Sanoptis schätzen wir Talent, Leidenschaft und Einstellung über spezifische Erfahrungen. Wir begrüßen Bewerber aus verschiedenen Hintergründen und priorisieren gleiche Chancen für alle. Kontakt Wenn Du Interesse an dieser spannenden Herausforderung hast und Teil unseres wachsenden Teams werden möchtest, sende uns bitte Deinen Lebenslauf unter Angabe Deiner Gehaltsvorstellung sowie Deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins. Wir freuen uns darauf, von Dir zu hören! Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

planqc builds neutral atom quantum computers in Garching. Behind every experiment and every line of control software sits an IT setup that has to work: laptops that are ready on day one, accounts that exist when someone starts, and hardware that is where it should be.

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at <u><span><a href="http://grafana.com" target="_blank">grafana.com</a></span></u> and follow us on <u><span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/grafana-labs/" target="_blank">LinkedIn</a></span></u> and <u><span><a href="https://twitter.com/grafana" target="_blank">X</a></span></u><u>.</u></p> <p>We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><p><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 10pt;">This is a remote position. We are considering candidates in Germany, Ireland, Sweden, Spain and the UK only.</span></strong></p> <p><strong>The Opportunity:</strong></p> <p>At Grafana Labs, we build observability tools that help users understand, respond to, and improve their systems – regardless of scale, complexity, or tech stack. We recently started a skunkworks initiative with a mission to bring observability to the rest of the business via general data analytics. Our goal is to make Grafana the single best place where humans and AI agents understand and act on data from across the enterprise. We build systems that help users make sense of their sea of data through AI-driven features in use cases like product analytics and sales data. These capabilities lower the barrier of domain expertise and surface meaningful signals from messy data.&nbsp;</p> <p>The 2H team is a mix of seasoned Grafanistas and new hires. We operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, both as individuals and as a team. Engineers are empowered to make decisions, move quickly, and validate ideas early – while being supported by a deeply collaborative culture that values curiosity, feedback, and cross-functional partnership.</p> <p>We’re looking for an AI Software Engineer with a strong software engineering background, a quick iteration mindset, and a passion for experimentation – balanced by a focus on shipping and scaling impactful features that deliver value to users. As part of our skunkworks initiative, you'll wear multiple hats and won't rely on cross-functional teams that typically support other teams inside Grafana Labs engineering. You will design, develop, test, and ship AI-powered features that can manage dealing with large datasets, while also expanding the capabilities of analytics-focused AI agents to assist users with information retrieval. As the team matures, there’s a broad opportunity to expand or redefine this role based on impact and initiative.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Be Doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and deliver AI solutions: Take ownership of developing delightful, high-performance AI features to help users discover, organize, and optimize access to large datasets.</li> <li>Rapid experimentation and iteration: Implement a highly iterative process where you quickly prototype, test, and validate with real users, including shipping and evolving LLM- or agent-powered workflows for the data engineering lifecycle.</li> <li>Collaborate: Work with the rest of the team to shape AI-driven product features, including the integration of agentic components with internal tools like Slack and alerting systems while engaging with internal data teams for dogfooding.</li> <li>Utilize AI tools effectively: Use AI and automation tools to enhance both product functionality and your own development workflows.&nbsp;</li> <li>Effective communication: You’ll be working in a highly dynamic and collaborative environment, so we need someone who can communicate effectively and contribute across teams.</li> <li>Ownership and impact: Take full ownership of the AI solutions you develop, ensuring they are not only innovative but also scalable, maintainable, and aligned with real user workflows.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You a Great Fit:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong engineering skills: Solid experience building production-grade, user-facing software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems and making UI design decisions with minimal supervision.</li> <li>AI experience with a practical mindset: You’re familiar with AI technologies and frameworks, and you focus on delivering high-quality solutions that work in the real world, not just in theory.&nbsp;</li> <li>Quick iteration and experimentation: You’re comfortable releasing prototypes, collecting feedback, and iterating with a pragmatic mindset.</li> <li>Proven initiative: You take ownership and drive projects forward, pushing boundaries to find the most impactful solutions. You can deal with ambiguity and are able to define scope where things are loosely defined.&nbsp;</li> <li>Collaborative attitude: You communicate effectively with your peers. You’re open to feedback, and you bring a solutions-oriented mindset to the table.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with LLMs, context engineering, and building applications powered by GenAI.</li> <li>Proven track record of delivering software that made it into production and is actively used by users.&nbsp;</li> <li>Exposure to working in cloud-native environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).</li> <li>Experience using observability tools to understand and troubleshoot system behavior.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience building or working with agent frameworks or multi‑agent workflows.</li> <li>Experience as a data analyst or work with data platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, Snowflake, DataBricks)</li> <li>Experience building tools for data engineering.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation &amp; Rewards:</strong></p> <p>In Germany, the Base compensation range for this role is <span data-sheets-root="1">€109,000 - €137,000.</span>&nbsp;Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed <a class="c-link" href="https://grafana.com/about/careers/#jobs" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://grafana.com/about/careers/#jobs" data-sk="tooltip_parent">here</a>.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range &amp; benefits at the beginning of the process.</em></p> <p><strong>Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong data-stringify-type="bold">100% Remote, Global Culture -&nbsp;</strong>As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.</li> <li><strong>Scaling Organization</strong> – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.</li> <li><strong>Transparent Communication</strong> – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.</li> <li><strong>Innovation-Driven</strong> – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.</li> <li><strong>Open Source Roots</strong> – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.</li> <li><strong>Empowered Teams</strong> – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.</li> <li><strong>Career Growth Pathways</strong> – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.</li> <li><strong>Approachable Leadership</strong> – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.</li> <li><strong>Passionate People</strong> – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.</li> <li><strong>In-Person onboarding </strong>- We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Balance is Key</strong> - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. <em>*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Employer:</strong> <em>Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.</em></p> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.</em></p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> </div> <div><em>For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our <a href="https://grafana.com/legal/applicant-and-candidate-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">privacy policy</a>.&nbsp;</em></div> <div>&nbsp;</div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Specialist, Employee Relations - EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Remote</strong></h2> <div><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.<br><br><span class="discussion-id-2f7cb4da-dab4-8068-a80f-001c50b2d808 suggestion-update notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.</span><br><br>We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.</span></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!</span></div></div><h2>What this job can offer you</h2> <p>As a critical extension of our clients’ HR teams, we navigate and advise on the intricate paths of global employment with unmatched speed, expertise, and precision. The vision of the Lifecycle team at Remote is not just about maintaining the gold standard in HR practices; it’s about elevating it, integrating cutting-edge technology solutions, and enriching customer experiences in over 80+ countries. On this team, your work directly influences our ability to sustain and extend our compliance coverage, continuously enhance our customer journeys, and significantly increase our operational capacity. You’re not just part of a team; you’re at the forefront of shaping the future of work, ensuring every interaction is fast, intuitive, and profoundly impactful. Dive into a role where your passion for innovation, commitment to excellence, and drive to make a global difference aligns with our mission to empower organizations worldwide to employ anyone, anywhere — compliantly.</p> <p>The Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations &amp; Transitions manages employee exits for Remote's external employees with a focus on legal compliance and providing delightful customer service. Additionally, the specialist provides first-level Employee Relations support, guiding clients through workplace concerns and coordinating appropriate resources when needed.</p> <p>As part of a larger employee Lifecycle team, the Specialist is also expected to contribute to process improvements and initiatives in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.</p> <h2>Key Responsibilities</h2> <h3>Offboarding</h3> <ul> <li>Manage and resolve end-to-end employee exits across multiple international jurisdictions, prioritizing a superior offboarding experience for Remote's clients and their employees.</li> <li>Provide sound guidance and manage clients' requests on various HR matters, including but not limited to termination, resignation and transfer procedures, employment contracts, and redundancy processes, ensuring legal compliance and best practices.</li> <li>Lead and facilitate meetings with clients and external employees, including but not limited to workforce reduction consultation meetings, administrative hearings, negotiations in separations and settlements, providing guidance on terminations, and delivering termination outcomes.</li> <li>Influence and negotiate positive outcomes in complex terminations, balancing multiple stakeholders with competing interests.</li> <li>Liaise with and coordinate various internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance in offboarding activities and audits, including but not limited to payroll, legal counsel, government bodies, and trade unions.</li> <li>Draft, tailor and administer all termination and supplementary documents with accuracy and attention to detail, ensuring employee records are maintained with strict adherence to privacy and confidentiality regulations.</li> <li>Process offboarding on Remote's internal HRIS platform, collaborating with various internal stakeholders, such as Customer Success, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Time and Attendance, amongst other verticals, to ensure all aspects of the employee exit are administered correctly and promptly.</li> <li>Be the subject-matter expert and respond to internal and external queries on all offboarding matters in conjunction with Lifecycle's internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Navigate clients through Remote's Employee Relations resources and guides, helping them understand applicable policies and processes.</li> <li>Conduct preliminary assessment of workplace concerns, identifying key facts and applicable local regulations.</li> <li>Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure appropriate handling of employee relations matters.</li> <li>Support clients in understanding progressive disciplinary approaches and documentation requirements.</li> <li>Monitor ongoing employee relations cases, ensuring timely follow-up and coordination with relevant stakeholders.</li> <li>Actively identify opportunities for and contribute to process improvements, automation, product development and overall customer and employee experience through the offboarding and employee relations processes.</li> </ul> <h2>Key Requirements and Charactristics</h2> <ul> <li>Experience as a HR Advisor or HR Business Partner, with generalist HR competencies and exposure across the employee lifecycle.</li> <li>Proven experience with a strong background in managing voluntary and involuntary exits (terminations) with care, sensitivity and legal compliance; and providing comprehensive HR support and guidance on employment laws and regulations, spanning various jurisdictions.</li> <li>Ability to interpret and apply industrial instruments, analyze complex HR issues, undertake research, provide practical solutions and effectively communicate recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders when operating in ambiguous and unfamiliar environments.</li> <li>Basic understanding of employee relations principles, progressive discipline approaches, and workplace investigation fundamentals.</li> <li>Excellent communication, influencing, conflict management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to confidently lead difficult conversations to a positive outcome, often where parties have conflicting interests, maintaining professionalism and strict confidentiality.</li> <li>Business-level (advanced) proficiency in written and spoken English, with additional languages considered a plus.</li> <li>Aptitude and appetite to innovate and optimize processes, continuously identifying and implementing opportunities for automation and championing best practices.</li> <li>Efficiency in operations, with an awareness of the importance of thorough record-keeping and data integrity.</li> <li>Tech-savvy, with the ability to successfully collaborate asynchronously on various tools, and adapt to new and evolving systems.</li> <li>Ability to work autonomously and cohesively in an international team in a fast-paced, asynchronous, remote environment with multiple priorities. Willingness to work flexible hours as needed.</li> <li>Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.</li> <li><strong>Demonstrates strong automation and AI capabilities and AI fluency.</strong></li> </ul> <h2>Practicals</h2> <ul> <li><strong>You'll report to: </strong>Manager Employee Lifecycle, Employee Relations &amp; Transitions</li> <li><strong>Team: </strong>Lifecycle, Employee Relations &amp; Transitions</li> <li><strong>Location</strong>: EMEA</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Application process</strong></h2> <ol> <li>Interview with recruiter</li> <li>Take Home Exercise</li> <li>Interview with future manager</li> <li>Interview with team members (no managers present)</li> <li>Interview with Senior Manager</li> <li>Bar Raiser</li> <li><a href="https://www.notion.so/Veremark-Remote-96e108c037b8423cbd4c3f07a1f9b38b?pvs=21">Prior employment verification check</a></li> </ol> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>Remote's <a href="https://www.notion.so/remotecom/people-Total-Rewards-1945bce8d3924ece9421ba8630f57b0c">Total Rewards philosophy</a> is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair <span class="link-annotation-unknown-block-id-1691622878">equity</span><span class="discussion-level-1 discussion-id-f2a82bc4-09e4-4a71-ad93-755b1d26a690 notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="3"> pay </span>along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.</p> <p>At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce.&nbsp; We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.<br><br>Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.<br><br><em data-stringify-type="italic">At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards &amp; People Enablement team on a case by case basis.</em></p></div><div class="title">The annual salary range for this full-time position is</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$46,500</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$104,650 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Benefits</strong></h2> <div class="p-rich_text_section"> <div class="p-rich_text_section"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Our full benefits &amp; perks are explained in our handbook at&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="http://remote.com/r/benefits" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://remote.com/r/benefits" data-sk="tooltip_parent">remote.com/r/benefits</a>. IT equipment</span></li> </ul> </div> <h2><strong>How you’ll plan your day (and life)</strong></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at <a href="https://remote.com/async" target="_blank">remote.com/async</a>.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your <strong>life-work balance</strong> is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If that sounds like something you want, apply now!</span></p> <h2><strong>How to apply</strong></h2> <ol> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong data-stringify-type="bold">We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.</strong></span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; text-align: left;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested in talking to us, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.</span></li> </ol> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><p><strong>Position Purpose:</strong></p> <p>The <strong>Senior Strategist, Data &amp; AI</strong> strengthens the capacity of RTSL and its government partners to use data, digital systems, and artificial intelligence to improve public health programs and decision-making. Working across RTSL's program portfolio, the role brings together public health strategy, data architecture, digital transformation, and AI governance to identify high-value opportunities and help translate them into practical, sustainable approaches.</p> <p>The Senior Strategist advises program and country teams on data architecture, interoperability, data governance, and AI readiness; shapes and prioritizes data- and AI-enabled initiatives; and builds RTSL's capacity to use emerging technologies responsibly and effectively. Externally, the role works with governments, technical partners, and the broader global health ecosystem to advance country-owned approaches to stronger data systems and responsible AI.</p> <p>Success in the role means that RTSL and its partners are making better-informed decisions about where and how to invest in data and AI, with stronger underlying data systems, clearer standards and safeguards, and practical applications that deliver measurable public health value.</p> <p><strong>Core Duties and Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p><strong><em>Data Strategy and Architecture</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Advise RTSL program and country teams and government partners on strengthening the data foundations needed for effective public health programs, including data architecture, quality, interoperability, metadata, governance, accessibility, and appropriate data use.</li> <li>Ensure teams understand how data flows across systems and identify fragmentation, duplication, quality issues, and other barriers to effective program management and decision-making.</li> <li>Support governments and partners in developing practical, sustainable approaches to data architecture and interoperability that strengthen existing systems and promote country ownership.</li> <li>Translate public health and program needs into clear data requirements and help bridge communication among public health, epidemiology, product, data, and technology teams.</li> <li>Ensure high standards for data quality, usability, interoperability, governance, privacy, and sustainability in collaboration with IT, Legal, and relevant technical teams.</li> <li>Track developments in health information architecture, interoperability standards, digital public goods, analytics, and related fields and assess their implications for RTSL's programs and country partnerships.</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>Applied AI, Innovation, and Responsible Use</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Shape RTSL's approach to the responsible programmatic use of AI and advanced analytics, ensuring that investments are driven by public health problems and measurable value rather than technology alone.</li> <li>Identify and prioritize high-value opportunities where AI could improve planning, implementation, clinical or public health decision support, analysis, monitoring, or learning -- in close collaboration with mechanisms for identifying and responding to risks.</li> <li>Lead responsible experimentation and learning, helping RTSL distinguish promising innovations from approaches that are not sufficiently countries, ensuring that evidence, successes, and failures inform future strategy, investment, and implementation.</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>External Advisory, Partnerships, and Cross-Functional Collaboration</em></strong></p> <ul> <li>Advise government and public health partners on data architecture, interoperability, governance, organizational readiness, and responsible AI adoption in About SINGU

At SINGU, we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.

 

Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide, supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus.

 

If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation.

About the Role

You'll own a significant slice of the SINGU product suite: space management and Soft FM services – cleaning standards, portering, and catering – used every day primarily across the UK healthcare market. Product-market fit is established and thousands of users depend on these products daily. What the portfolio needs now is strategic direction and taking them to their next level of growth.

You'll do that through a team of four Product Managers who are domain experts in the products they run. This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll stay close to customer problems yourself, you'll raise the bar on how the team discovers and validates work, and you'll have real autonomy to decide what's worth building – and to prove it works.

SINGU group grows both organically and through acquisition, and several of these products arrived with the companies that built them. You'll shape the strategy for bringing them into one coherent ecosystem and lead your team through that change. If you enjoy taking a set of good but separate products and making them add up to something bigger, that is the interesting part of this job.

You'll partner closely with Sales, Engineering, and Product colleagues across the SINGU Group so your portfolio drives revenue and solves real problems across the European FM market. AI is a must-have lever in our industry rather than a talking point: you'll be applying it where it measurably improves how our customers run their estates.

This is a remote position with periodic travel to London and Kraków – roughly every two to four weeks.

Role Scope

People Leadership & Team Development:

  • Manage and develop the Product Managers within the product team.

  • Own the full management lifecycle: hiring, onboarding, mentorship, feedback, coaching, performance evaluations, promotions, and exits.

  • Foster a high-performing product culture based on customer empathy, data-driven decision-making, and outcome orientation.

  • Manage staffing and focus areas across the suite, reallocating product resources where needed to balance discovery workload and meet strategic priorities.

  • Lead the team through change – new ways of working, a shifting portfolio, and product consolidation – bringing people with you rather than around them.

Product Discovery & Strategy:

  • Define and maintain product roadmaps aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and market trends.

  • Decide where to invest and where to hold: set a clear, defensible position on which initiatives scale and communicate it across the business.

  • Build strong alignment with the Sales team to ensure product discovery and roadmap priorities actively unblock deals and support revenue growth.

  • Identify and resolve ambiguities, dependencies, and competing priorities that impact discovery quality and speed.

Product Management Best Practices & Standards:

  • Promote modern product practices, including continuous discovery, outcome-based roadmapping, and hypothesis-driven development.

  • Ensure product teams consistently validate assumptions through user research, experimentation, and data analysis.

  • Drive improvements in requirements quality, stakeholder communication, prioritization frameworks, and release planning.

  • Cooperate with the Chief Architect and Engineering Managers to ensure product decisions account for technical feasibility and platform constraints.

  • Drive the adoption of AI-powered tools and analytics to improve product insights, customer understanding, and decision-making quality.

Collaboration & Cross-Company Coordination:

  • Coordinate with commercial and customer-facing teams to align product strategy with go-to-market plans and revenue goals for the portfolio.

  • Represent the company at external events, conferences, and industry forums to share product insights, build the Group's profile, and stay connected to market trends.

  • Maintain alignment, knowledge sharing, and team cohesion with colleagues across the Group.

Experience & Requirements

Must have's:

  • 5+ years in product management, ideally with at least three of them in B2B SaaS. Strong B2C experience in FM, healthcare, or an adjacent domain is also worth a conversation.

  • At least two years leading a team as a people manager – product managers ideally, but we are flexible on the setup; what matters is that you have owned a team, not that you are ready to start.

  • Experience taking a team or a product area through real change: new ways of working, a restructure, or post-acquisition integration – and bringing the sceptics with you.

  • Demonstrable experience applying AI within product development, using AI-powered tooling to accelerate discovery and delivery.

  • Proven track record of leading product discovery across multiple methods and translating insights into validated roadmaps.

  • Strong commercial awareness: able to partner with Sales and align product decisions with revenue and retention goals.

  • Data fluency: comfortable defining metrics, querying product analytics, and using quantitative evidence to drive decisions.

  • Excellent stakeholder communication: able to frame trade-offs and build alignment across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • English at C1 or above, written and spoken, with the confidence to represent the product externally.

Nice to Have's:

  • Experience working in empowered product trios (or similar cross-functional squads) with engineering and design.

  • Experience in healthcare (ideally the UK market, NHS), public sector, or government-adjacent markets.

  • Familiarity with platform or multi-product portfolio environments.

  • Experience integrating acquired products into a single coherent platform.

  • Polish or German alongside English.

Why Here

An additional 28.97% employer pension contribution is paid on the base salary.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">This role sits outside of the&nbsp;</span><a href="https://ddat-capability-framework.service.gov.uk/"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">DDaT pay framework</span></span></a><span data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;given the scope of this role requires in depth technical&nbsp;expertise&nbsp;in frontier AI safety,&nbsp;robustness&nbsp;and advanced AI architectures.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The full range of salaries are available below:</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Level 3:</strong>&nbsp;£65,000–£75,000 (Base £39,850 + Technical Allowance £25,150–£35,150)</li> <li><strong>Level 4:</strong>&nbsp;£85,000–£95,000 (Base £47,355 + Technical Allowance £37,645–£47,645)</li> <li><strong>Level 5:</strong>&nbsp;£105,000–£115,000 (Base £61,620 + Technical Allowance £43,380–£53,380)</li> <li><strong>Level 6:</strong>&nbsp;£125,000–£135,000 (Base £74,605 + Technical Allowance £50,395–£60,395)</li> <li><strong>Level 7:</strong>&nbsp;£145,000 (Base £74,605 + Technical Allowance £70,395)</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <hr> <h4>Additional Information</h4> <div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_nullclass"> <h3><span style="font-size: 8pt;"><strong>Use of AI in Applications</strong></span></h3> <p><span style="font-size: 8pt;">Artificial Intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our&nbsp;<u><a href="https://eur02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.civil-service-careers.gov.uk%2Fartificial-intelligence-and-recruitment%2F&amp;data=05%7C02%7CLynn.Tan%40dsit.gov.uk%7Ccf5d753b7f19427afc8f08de4c307014%7Ccbac700502c143ebb497e6492d1b2dd8%7C0%7C0%7C639031968075235036%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&amp;sdata=jCrYoy62YfXN%2FLIB%2FhtHxdLGbCOgropbkZXDyQsUMC4%3D&amp;reserved=0" target="_blank" data-outlook-id="02db05e7-03ca-4ca6-bcd9-73ff8bf258f2" data-auth="NotApplicable" data-linkindex="1">candidate guidance&nbsp;</a></u>for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.</span></p> <h3><span style="font-size: 8pt;"><strong>Internal Fraud Database</strong>&nbsp;</span></h3> <p><span style="font-size: 8pt;">The Internal Fraud function of the Fraud, Error, Debt and Grants Function at the Cabinet Office processes details of civil servants who have been dismissed for committing internal fraud, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned. The Cabinet Office receives the details from participating government organisations of civil servants who have been dismissed, or who would have been dismissed had they not resigned, for internal fraud. In instances such as this, civil servants are then banned for 5 years from further employment in the civil service. The Cabinet Office then processes this data and discloses a limited dataset back to DLUHC as a participating government organisations. DLUHC then carry out the pre employment checks so as to detect instances where known fraudsters are attempting to reapply for roles in the civil service. In this way, the policy is ensured and the repetition of internal fraud is prevented.&nbsp; </span><span style="font-size: 8pt;">For more information please see -&nbsp;<a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/internal-fraud-register-privacy-notice/internal-fraud-register-privacy-notice">Internal Fraud Register.</a></span></p> <h3><span style="font-size: 8pt;">Security</span></h3> <span style="font-size: 8pt;">Successful candidates must undergo a criminal record check and get&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/government-baseline-personnel-security-standard" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/government-baseline-personnel-security-standard" data-sk="tooltip_parent">baseline personnel security standard (BPSS)&nbsp;clearance</a>&nbsp;before they can be appointed. Additionally, there is a strong preference for eligibility for&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/national-security-vetting-advice-for-people-who-are-being-vetted" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/national-security-vetting-advice-for-people-who-are-being-vetted" data-sk="tooltip_parent">counter-terrorist check (CTC)&nbsp;clearance</a>. Some roles may require higher levels of clearance, and we will state this by exception in the job advertisement.&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/vetting-explained-and-our-vetting-charter/the-vetting-charter" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/vetting-explained-and-our-vetting-charter/the-vetting-charter" data-sk="tooltip_parent">See our vetting charter here.</a></span></div> </div> <div class="vac_display_field"> <h3><span style="font-size: 8pt;">Nationality requirements</span></h3> <p><span style="font-size: 8pt;">We may be able to offer roles to applicant from <strong>any nationality or background</strong>. As such we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet the standard <a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/nationality-rules" target="_blank">nationality requirements (opens in a new window).</a></span></p> </div> <div class="vac_display_field"> <h3><span style="font-size: 8pt;">Working for the Civil Service</span></h3> <div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"><span style="font-size: 8pt;">The&nbsp;<a href="http://civilservicecommission.independent.gov.uk/code/" target="_blank">Civil Service Code (opens in a new window)</a> sets out the standards of behaviour expected of civil servants.&nbsp;The Civil Service embraces diversity and promotes equal opportunities. As such, we run a Disability Confident Scheme (DCS) for candidates with disabilities who meet the minimum selection criteria.&nbsp;The Civil Service also offers a Redeployment Interview Scheme to civil servants who are at risk of redundancy, and who meet the minimum requirements for the advertised vacancy.</span></div> </div> </div> <div class="vac_display_field"> <h3><span style="font-size: 8pt;">Diversity and Inclusion</span></h3> <div class="vac_display_field_value"><span style="font-size: 8pt;">The Civil Service is committed to attract, retain and invest in talent wherever it is found. To learn more please see the&nbsp;<a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/civil-service-people-plan-2024-2027/civil-service-people-plan-2024-2027-html" target="_blank">Civil Service People Plan (opens in a new window)</a>&nbsp;and the&nbsp;<a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/civil-service-diversity-and-inclusion-strategy-2022-to-2025" target="_blank">Civil Service Diversity and Inclusion Strategy (opens in a new window)</a>. As part of the application process, we monitor statistics on D&amp;I. You can see how we process this data here: <a href="https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/government-digital-service-recruitment-privacy-notice/recruitment-privacy-notice" target="_blank">Recruitment privacy notice - GOV.UK</a>.</span></div> </div></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About the AI Security Institute</h2> <p>The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.</p> <p>We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.</p></div><h2><span class="TextRun SCXW212922402 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW212922402 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">The deadline for applying to this role is 30</span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW212922402 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun Superscript CommentHighlightRest SCXW212922402 BCX8" data-fontsize="12" data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">th</span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW212922402 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun CommentHighlightRest SCXW212922402 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">&nbsp;September 2026</span><span class="NormalTextRun CommentHighlightPipeRest SCXW212922402 BCX8" data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">, end of day, anywhere on Earth.</span></span><span class="EOP Selected SCXW212922402 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;134245418&quot;:true,&quot;134245529&quot;:true,&quot;335557856&quot;:16777215,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0}">&nbsp;</span></h2> <h2>Team Description</h2> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Control measures — monitors, permission systems, sandboxing, resampling, escalation protocols — are designed to detect and prevent misaligned behaviour from advanced AI systems. Though the measures are already critical to safety, whether they would in fact catch a capable model attempting to cause harm is an empirical question that remains largely untested. </span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;335559739&quot;:160}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The Control Red Team at AISI is stress-testing control monitors (</span><a href="https://www.aisi.gov.uk/blog/how-our-new-control-red-team-is-stress-testing-frontier-monitors"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">including</span> <span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">from GDM and Anthropic</span></span></a><span data-contrast="auto">) – finding attacks that beat monitors and attempting to design experiments to measure real-world risk.   • Experience integrating Workday with ATS (e.g. Ashby), payroll (ADP), Microsoft Entra, benefits platforms (Thanksben)

You'll join at a live, post-go-live stage of Workday's evolution at Neko Health, meaning your work has immediate visibility and impact, not years of legacy debt to untangle first.

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. Through analysis, stakeholder engagement, workshops and practical demonstrations, you will help make AI transformation tangible, accessible and valuable for our clients.</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Process Reimagination: </strong>Support clients in exploring how services, Identification: </strong>Work with client teams to identify opportunities where AI can improve outcomes, efficiency and service delivery, helping assess feasibility, risks and potential value.</li> tangible proof points rather than theory.</li> <li><strong>Research &amp; Insight Development: </strong>Maintain awareness of developments across GenAI tools, AI-enabled services and public sector adoption trends, translating emerging capabilities into practical insights for clients and engagement teams.</li> <li><strong>Client Delivery: </strong>Take ownership of high-quality deliverables </strong>Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of Baringa's AI methodologies, playbooks, frameworks and reusable assets, helping strengthen our Government AI capability.</li> additional value for clients.</li> <li><strong>Team Contribution:</strong> Actively participate in Baringa's internal AI initiatives, sharing knowledge and supporting capability development across the wider Government practice.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">&nbsp;</span><br><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span>&nbsp;</span></h3> <ul> <li>Experience working within consulting, government, healthcare, local government or wider public sector environments, with exposure to transformation, digital, data or technology-enabled change.</li> <li>Understanding of how government organisations operate, including the practical constraints associated with governance, information security, data privacy and operational delivery.</li> <li>Strong interest in AI adoption and practical experience using leading AI ecosystems such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude or equivalent tools within day-to-day work.</li> <li>Experience supporting organisations in the adoption of new technologies, digital tools, operating model changes or transformation initiatives.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex issues and develop practical recommendations.</li> <li>Experience creating high-quality client-facing deliverables, presentations, reports and workshop materials.</li> <li>Ability to build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams.</li> <li>A proactive approach to learning, with curiosity about emerging AI developments and their practical application in public sector settings.</li> <li>Commitment to the responsible use of AI, with an appreciation of governance, risk and ethical considerations associated with AI adoption.</li> <li>A pragmatic mindset that focuses on creating measurable value and tangible outcomes rather than pursuing technology for its own sake.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <h3><br><span data-contrast="none"><span title: Senior UX Designer - Star Trek Fleet Command
description: <p>Scopely is looking for a <strong>Senior UX Designer</strong> to join our Star Trek Fleet Command team within our Live Games Portfolio division in the UK on a remote basis.</p> <p>At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.</p> <p>Star Trek Fleet Command is a standout success in the gaming industry. Launched in 2018, our in-house developed 4X Strategy MMO has continually evolved, earning its place as one of the top-grossing games on the market.</p> <h3>What You Will Do</h3> <ul> <li>Help shape the future of UX design on STFC, both through new features and through your own principles, practices, and standards.</li> <li>Own and deliver complete UX for new features and player experiences, turning ideas into fully developed designs that meet the experience targets of the product.</li> <li>Build deep knowledge of the game to effectively step into the player’s shoes and ground your design decisions in real player perspectives and experiences.</li> <li>Find relevant references and comps, deconstructing them to uncover inspiration and common pitfalls.</li> <li>Visualise ideas by producing a range of design deliverables that communicate your thinking and design intent. This includes sketches, low to medium fidelity wireframes, user flows, and interactive UX prototypes.</li> <li>Identify weak points in designs, gaps in thinking, and opportunities to better deliver on goals by applying critical thinking and a sharp design eye to strengthen solutions.</li> <li>Work closely with product teams, game designers and artists to refine ideas and stay aligned throughout development. Proactively share work, keep the right people informed, and provide relevant information when it’s needed.</li> <li>Leverage feedback, data, and other insights to refine designs—not just to react, but to reflect and make intentional improvements.</li> <li>Support long-term product and UX consistency through your design work by drawing on developed knowledge of our design principles and patterns.</li> </ul> <h3>What We're Looking For</h3> <ul> <li>Extensive experience specialising in game UX development, with a track record of delivering features or initiatives from concept to implementation.</li> <li>Confidence in navigating ambiguity, with the ability to identify next steps, recognise blockers, and take initiative to move work forward.</li> <li>A solutions-oriented mindset that goes beyond identifying problems, bringing thoughtful, creative problem solving to the table.</li> <li>A strong understanding of game development norms and pipelines, including how to design with technical constraints, implementation realities, and cross-discipline workflows in mind.</li> <li>A fit for a culture built on curiosity, improvement, creativity, and collaboration, paired with a genuine passion for both playing and making games that fuels thoughtful, player-centered design.</li> </ul> <p>Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.</p> <p>At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! &nbsp; We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us &amp; embrace the adventure!</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>About Scopely</h3> <p>Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.</p> <p>Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.</p> <p>Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.</p> <p>Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/">https://www.scopely.com/</a>.&nbsp;</p> <p>Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official <a href="http://scopely.com">website</a> and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @<a href="http://scopely.com">scopely.com</a>.</p> <p>Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact ----- Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-ca-residents">California Privacy Notice</a> and <a href="https://www.scopely.com/en/eea-and-uk-job-applicant-privacy-notice">EEA/UK Privacy Notice</a>.</p> <p>Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Risk team members</strong> work collaboratively across credit underwriting, portfolio monitoring, restructuring, recoveries and assurance, providing specialist expertise across all of Private Credit's lending strategies.&nbsp;</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td width="642"> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>Portfolio Review &amp; Risk Identification</strong></p> <ul> <li>Assist with, and ultimately take ownership of, portfolio review processes in partnership with portfolio management teams, ensuring early identification of risk and emerging trends across all lending strategies.</li> <li>Exercise delegated authority for non-material credit requests, escalating appropriately where thresholds are exceeded.</li> <li>Contribute to watchlist and early warning indicator processes, flagging deteriorating credits for further action.</li> <li>Contribute case-level input to Lessons Learnt processes, covering challenged cases, watchlist trends and emerging risk themes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Credit Underwriting Support &amp;
