title: Senior Ecommerce Manager – Commercial Trading & Strategy
description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <p><strong><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">About THG Ingenuity</span></strong></p> <p>THG Ingenuity is a fully integrated digital commerce ecosystem, designed to power brands without limits. Our global end-to-end tech platform is comprised of three products: THG Commerce, THG Studios, THG Fulfilment.&nbsp;</p> <p>Each represents a single, unified solution, overcoming challenges and taking brands direct-to-consumer. Our client portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Coca-Cola, Nestle, Elemis, Homebase, and Proctor &amp; Gamble.</p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 1">About the Role:</span></span></strong></p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">The Senior Ecommerce Manager is a senior commercial leadership role, responsible for setting and delivering the <strong>ecommerce trading, inventory and marketing strategy</strong> across a client account or vertical.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">This role goes beyond front-end ecommerce performance. You will take commercial ownership of how <strong>stock, product mix, margin, marketing investment and customer demand</strong> come together to drive sustainable growth.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You will lead the development of trading strategies aligned to buying cycles, product launches and inventory plans, ensuring that merchandising, marketing and operational teams are working towards a unified commercial objective.</p> <p class="isSelectedEnd">You’ll be responsible for understanding and influencing stock health, sell-through, stock cover, margin performance and product lifecycle, using this insight to shape promotional strategy, visual merchandising, marketing investment and customer acquisition activity.</p> <p>Acting as the bridge between the Ecommerce Manager layer and the Head of Ecommerce, you will provide strategic direction to your team while leading senior stakeholders across buying, merchandising, finance, marketing and operations. You will own the commercial narrative for your accounts and have the confidence to challenge decisions where stock, margin or customer demand are not aligned.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 1">Key Responsibilities:</span></span></strong></p> <p><em><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Strategic Trading, Inventory &amp; Commercial Performance</span></span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134245418&quot;:true,&quot;134245529&quot;:true,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:120}">&nbsp;</span></em></p> <ul> <li>Own the overall ecommerce trading strategy for your accounts, with responsibility for revenue, conversion, AOV, COS, ROAS, margin, sell-through, stock cover and inventory health.</li> <li>Develop trading strategies that are directly aligned to <strong>buying cycles, range plans, product launches, seasonal priorities and inventory positions</strong>.</li> <li>Take commercial ownership of stock performance, working with merchandising and finance teams to develop strategies for stock optimisation, clearance, markdowns and margin protection.</li> <li>Lead cross-functional alignment between ecommerce, merchandising, buying and operations to ensure a unified approach to achieving optimal stock levels and product mix.</li> <li>Monitor stock depth, width, availability, sell-through and aged inventory, identifying risks and opportunities and translating these into clear commercial actions.</li> <li>Use inventory insight to influence promotional strategy, product prioritisation, onsite visibility and marketing investment.</li> <li>Ensure the trading calendar reflects both customer demand and the commercial realities of the buying and inventory cycle.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to maximise full-price sales, improve sell-through and minimise aged or excess stock while protecting margin.</li> <li>Own the strategic approach to product lifecycle management, from launch and newness through to seasonal transitions, markdowns and end-of-life.</li> <li>Oversee site performance and customer journey optimisation, using data, customer behaviour and CRO insight to identify opportunities for sustainable growth.</li> <li>Lead competitor, pricing, promotional and market analysis to ensure clients remain commercially competitive.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Merchandising, Product &amp; Visual Strategy</span></span></strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Develop the overarching digital product and merchandising strategy in partnership with buying and category leaders.</li> <li>Attend brand and product showcases to understand upcoming product ranges, key USPs, product features, seasonal stories and commercial priorities.</li> <li>Translate product showcase insights into clear digital product strategies, including taxonomy, categorisation, onsite hierarchy, visual storytelling and content requirements.</li> <li>Define visual merchandising direction for key launches, seasonal campaigns and commercial events, ensuring the site reflects stock and margin priorities.</li> <li>Work with buying and category teams to establish product priority lists and inventory depth targets for key trading periods.</li> <li>Ensure ecommerce plans are informed by range architecture, product availability and anticipated customer demand.</li> <li>Develop merchandising capability and processes within the wider ecommerce team, embedding best practice and consistent ways of working.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Marketing &amp; Channel Leadership</span></span></strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Own the overarching multi-channel marketing strategy across SEO, PPC, Paid Social, CRM, Affiliates and Influencers.</li> <li>Lead channel strategy and investment decisions based on <strong>commercial performance, inventory health, margin and customer acquisition efficiency</strong>.</li> <li>Ensure marketing spend is dynamically aligned to product availability, stock depth, margin targets and strategic trading priorities.</li> <li>Use attribution modelling, customer data and channel performance insight to optimise budget allocation and improve CAC efficiency.</li> <li>Balance new customer acquisition with CLV, retention and profitability objectives.</li> <li>Identify where additional marketing investment can accelerate sell-through of priority or overstocked products without unnecessarily diluting margin.</li> <li>Challenge channel teams to demonstrate clear commercial contribution and ensure marketing activity supports the wider trading strategy.</li> <li>Develop sophisticated forecasts to inform channel budgets, sales targets and inventory-led trading decisions.</li> <li>Partner with creative, brand and data teams to ensure campaign execution reflects product priorities and commercial objectives.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Returns &amp; Customer Insight</span></span></strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Take strategic ownership of returns performance, identifying trends, root causes and commercial impact.</li> <li>Partner with buying, category, customer service and operational teams to reduce avoidable returns and improve product performance.</li> <li>Use returns data, customer feedback and behavioural insight to influence product content, imagery, sizing information and onsite communication.</li> <li>Identify products or categories with high return rates and develop cross-functional action plans to improve customer understanding and reduce return-related costs.</li> <li>Incorporate customer and returns insight into broader product, merchandising and trading strategies.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Buying, Merchandising &amp; Finance Partnership</span></span></strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Build strong strategic relationships with senior buying, category and merchandising stakeholders.</li> <li>Partner with Finance to understand margin performance, P&amp;L impact, stock valuation and commercial trade-offs.</li> <li>Work with buying leaders to ensure digital trading plans are aligned to range development, launch readiness and buying-cycle roadmaps.</li> <li>Challenge product mix, stock depth and promotional decisions using ecommerce, inventory and customer data.</li> <li>Establish shared commercial objectives across ecommerce, buying, merchandising, finance and operations.</li> <li>Lead regular reviews of stock health, margin, sell-through and trading performance, ensuring risks are identified early and action plans are clearly owned.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Client &amp; Stakeholder Management</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Act as the senior commercial point of contact for your clients, building trusted, strategic relationships.</li> <li>Own the commercial and strategic narrative for your accounts, translating complex trading, inventory and marketing data into clear recommendations.</li> <li>Lead QBRs, monthly business reviews and strategic planning sessions, presenting performance, risks, opportunities and forward-looking recommendations.</li> <li>Confidently challenge clients and internal stakeholders where decisions may negatively impact stock health, margin or commercial performance.</li> <li>Balance client ambition with operational capacity and commercial reality.</li> <li>Ensure client priorities are translated into clear actions across internal ecommerce, merchandising, marketing and operational teams.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Team Leadership &amp; Capability Development</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Lead, manage and develop a team of Ecommerce Managers and Executives.</li> <li>Set clear expectations around trading, merchandising, commercial analysis and data-led decision making.</li> <li>Develop the team's capability across inventory-led trading, visual merchandising, product lifecycle management and commercial optimisation.</li> <li>Coach team members to understand the relationship between stock, margin, customer demand and marketing performance.</li> <li>Establish consistent processes and best practice across trading and merchandising activity.</li> <li>Identify capability gaps and lead projects to improve the team's overall commercial effectiveness.</li> <li>Create a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership &amp; Project Ownership</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Lead complex cross-functional projects spanning ecommerce, buying, merchandising, finance, marketing, logistics and operations.</li> <li>Champion a unified approach to stock, trading and commercial performance across all relevant departments.</li> <li>Own strategic initiatives from initial opportunity identification through to implementation, measurement and optimisation.</li> <li>Establish clear project governance, milestones, responsibilities and success measures.</li> <li>Ensure projects deliver measurable improvements in revenue, margin, stock efficiency, customer experience or operational performance.</li> <li>Share market insight, commercial best practice and strategic learnings across the wider ecommerce function.</li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 1">What We’re Looking For:</span></span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant senior ecommerce experience spanning <strong>commercial trading, merchandising and digital marketing</strong>, ideally within a retailer, DTC, agency or managed services environment.</li> <li>Proven experience managing <strong>inventory-led trading and stock performance</strong> within an ecommerce or retail environment.</li> <li>Strong understanding of stock cover, sell-through, inventory depth and width, product lifecycle, aged stock and stock optimisation.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience partnering with <strong>buying, merchandising/category and finance leaders</strong> to make commercial decisions.</li> <li>Proven experience developing merchandising capability, processes and best practice.</li> <li>Strong commercial understanding of <strong>margin, P&amp;L, COS, markdowns, promotional mechanics and profitability</strong>.</li> <li>Experience influencing product mix and inventory strategy based on customer demand, trading performance and commercial objectives.</li> <li>Strong understanding of visual merchandising and the ability to translate product and buying strategy into digital execution.</li> <li>Experience analysing returns data and implementing strategies to reduce return rates.</li> <li>Strong understanding of digital marketing channels including SEO, PPC, Paid Social, CRM, Affiliates and Influencers.</li> <li>Experience using attribution, customer and performance data to optimise marketing investment and improve CAC efficiency.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams across ecommerce, merchandising, buying, finance, marketing and operations.</li> <li>Strong project management experience, with demonstrable ownership of complex commercial initiatives from strategy through to delivery.</li> <li>Proven people leadership experience, with the ability to develop capability and drive high performance.</li> <li>Highly analytical and commercially astute, with the ability to turn complex data into clear strategic decisions.</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder and client management skills, with confidence influencing senior stakeholders and challenging decisions constructively.</li> <li>Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment with multiple competing priorities.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>THG Ingenuity is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.</strong></p> <p><strong>THG Ingenuity is committed to creating a diverse &amp; inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.</strong></p> <p><strong>Because of the high volumes of applications our opportunities attract, it sometimes takes us time to review and consider them all. raw.description:
Who We Are:

At Bandwidth, we shape how the world connects. We're the global communications software company and Tier 1 network operator with global reach.  The voice, messaging, and emergency services infrastructure behind the brands and apps you use every day.

Because we own the network we build on, the problems you'll solve here are bigger, more complex, and more impactful. And as communications shifts to AI, we're the infrastructure layer making it possible.

We call ourselves BANDmates because building something this big takes collaboration, different perspectives, and the freedom to bring your authentic self to the table.

We're experts who speak like humans. Ready to build what's next? #JoinTheBand

What We Are Looking For:

Bandwidth is building a dedicated Salesforce Alliance team to win the global contact center market. As Director of Salesforce Alliance Pipeline & Development, you will own and grow Bandwidth's relationship with Salesforce — building the contacts, credibility, and pipeline motion that makes Bandwidth the undisputed carrier of choice for Salesforce's Agentforce contact center platform.

You will be Bandwidth's face to Salesforce's partner and field teams globally, coordinating inbound and outbound lead flow, aligning go-to-market strategy, and managing two field-based direct reports who work the Salesforce event circuit in Europe and North America.

This is a high-visibility, externally-facing role that requires deep knowledge of Salesforce's internal structure, the contact center ecosystem, and carrier-grade voice and messaging.

What You'll Do:

SALESFORCE RELATIONSHIP OWNERSHIP

  • Build and maintain deep, trusted relationships across Salesforce's partner, alliances, Agentforce, and contact center teams — from individual contributors to executive sponsors
  • Serve as Bandwidth's primary point of contact for Salesforce's ISV/partner and co-sell programs
  • Maintain a comprehensive map of Salesforce contacts relevant to contact center, Agentforce, and the carrier partner ecosystem
  • Facilitate executive engagement between Bandwidth and Salesforce leadership on a regular cadence

PIPELINE GENERATION & LEAD FLOW

  • Drive mutual pipeline between Bandwidth and Salesforce — both generating leads from Salesforce and routing Bandwidth-sourced leads into Salesforce deals
  • Build and manage a structured lead-exchange process with Salesforce's alliance and field teams
  • Track and report Salesforce-influenced and co-sell pipeline, maintaining accurate data in CRM
  • Set pipeline generation targets for the team and hold direct reports accountable

AGENTFORCE CONTACT CENTER STRATEGY

  • Develop and maintain Bandwidth's value proposition for Salesforce's Agentforce contact center — articulating why Bandwidth is the right carrier partner
  • Understand the competitive landscape in contact center carriers (Twilio, Vonage, NICE, Genesys, Five9, etc.) and keep Salesforce informed of Bandwidth's differentiation
  • Work with Bandwidth product and marketing teams to ensure Salesforce-relevant content, case studies, and technical documentation are current
  • Support Salesforce field teams in positioning Bandwidth on active contact center pursuits

TEAM LEADERSHIP

  • Manage and develop two Field Alliance Executives (Europe and North America)
  • Coach direct reports on Salesforce's internal contacts, deal mechanics, and co-sell motion
  • Set quarterly OKRs for the team aligned to Bandwidth's Salesforce partnership goals
  • Represent the team's results to Bandwidth leadership

EVENTS & EXECUTIVE PRESENCE

  • Plan and execute Bandwidth's presence at Salesforce events: World Tour London, Dreamforce (San Francisco), World Tour New York, and other regional events
  • Represent Bandwidth at Salesforce partner summits, QBRs, and advisory boards

What You Need:

  • 7+ years in partnerships, alliances, or channel sales — ideally in SaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, or carrier/telecom
  • Direct experience working within or alongside the Salesforce ecosystem (ISV partner, Salesforce employee, or Salesforce-focused sales role)
  • Demonstrable contact network within Salesforce's partner, ISV, or field organization
  • Deep understanding of the contact center market — platforms, carriers, competitive dynamics
  • Experience managing and developing a team
  • Exceptional executive presence and relationship-building skills
  • Based in London or willing to relocate

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with Salesforce's AppExchange ISV program or Salesforce Partner Program
  • Familiarity with carrier-grade voice, SIP, or CPaaS
  • Experience at a global communications provider (Twilio, NICE, Genesys, Vonage, 8x8, or similar)
  • Network within the Salesforce Agentforce / Einstein for Service team

What Success Looks Like — First 12 Months

  • Deep, active relationships established across Salesforce's partner, Agentforce, and field organization
  • Structured lead-exchange process in place and generating measurable pipeline
  • Both direct reports ramped, active at Salesforce events, and running co-sell motions
  • Bandwidth positioned as the go-to carrier reference for Salesforce contact center deals
  • Active pipeline attributable to the Salesforce alliance visible in CRM

The Whole Person Promise: 

At Bandwidth, we're pretty proud of our corporate culture, which is rooted in our "Whole Person Promise." We promise all employees that they can have meaningful work AND a full life, and we provide a work environment geared toward enriching your body, mind, and spirit. How do we do that? Well…

  • Work laptop & mobile phone with a competitive subscription plan, and an internet allowance to support the costs of the Internet at home.
  • We contribute 8% of your monthly gross salary into your private pension.
  • Income protection plan to ensure you'll receive a regular income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury.
  • Life insurance providing financial support to your loved ones in the event of your unexpected passing.
  • Health insurance, with extensive coverage, a simple claim process and the possibility to cover your life partner and children.
  • Extensive Employee Assistance Programme, offering 24/7 counseling and support on all areas of life (personal and professional).
  • Unlimited, free and anonymous consultations with our dedicated therapist.
  • Childcare support
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • 24 days annual leave per year and 1 additional day every 3 years.
  • Time-Off Embargo. When you take time off (of any kind!) you're embargoed from working. Bandmates and managers are not allowed to interrupt your time-off - not even with email.
  • Additional time-off can be earned throughout the year through volunteer hours and Bandwidth challenges.
  • "Mahalo moments" program grants additional time off for life's most important moments like graduations, buying a first home, getting married, wedding anniversaries (every five years), and the birth of a grandchild.
  • 90-Minute Workout Lunches, contribution to your monthly fitness subscription and unlimited virtual meetings with our very own nutritionist.

 

Are you excited about the position and its responsibilities, but not sure if you're 100% qualified? Do you feel you can work to help us crush the mission? If you answered 'yes' to both of these questions, we encourage you to apply! You won't want to miss the opportunity to be a part of the BAND.

title: Senior Product Designer
description: Meet DeepL DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation. Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures. Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination. What sets us apart What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected. When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture. What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog . Meet the team behind this journey As a Senior Product Designer at DeepL, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the translation experience at the heart of DeepL Translate, the AI-first translation platform millions of people reach for every day to localize their content. You'll join a cross-functional team that is central to delivering a fast, trustworthy, and scalable product, collaborating closely with product managers and engineering leaders to define and drive the product vision. Beyond your immediate team, you will actively contribute to DeepL's broader design community—helping evolve our craft, influence best practices, and raise the bar for design across the company. This is a high-impact role for a designer who is comfortable navigating complexity, cares deeply about user experience, and thrives in collaborative, strategic environments. Your responsibilities You will be responsible for solving a critical problem: making translation feel effortless and trustworthy for anyone who needs to communicate across languages — whether they're translating a sentence, a document, or their daily work. We expect you to: Become an expert on who our users are and what each user group needs, from casual translators to professionals who rely on DeepL every day Conduct generative and evaluative user research to define problems and validate solutions Gather and evaluate requirements with cross-functional team members Communicate design concepts early and often, backed by qualitative insights and quantitative data Deliver vibe coded prototypes, final design specifications in Figma and make small code changes in production Share the responsibility to maintain and expand the design system Qualities we look for You have 4+ years of experience in product teams providing design solutions for web applications You have a strong understanding of user-centered design processes You have experience designing for B2B audiences but have a great eye for design. Experience in B2C design is a bonus point You can drive design throughout the whole lifecycle of an idea — discovering problems, defining success, evaluating solutions, and measuring impact You understand the power of storytelling and are comfortable in driving stakeholders buy-in You can consistently use qualitative and quantitative insights to guide your design process You are confident owning and co-owning design artefacts in Figma You are as confident in using AI to support your work, especially to create design assets and prototypes, we mostly use Claude Code You have experience working on a product at scale with a global presence You have strong communication and presentation skills You are fluent in English. Any other languages, e.g. German, are an advantage What we offer Diverse and internationally distributed team : joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network. Open communication, regular feedback : as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together. Hybrid work, flexible hours : we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration. Regular in-person team events : we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally. Monthly full-day hacking sessions : every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity. 30 days of annual leave : we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally. Competitive benefits : just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way. If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you! We are an equal opportunity employer You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.   • Conduct generative and evaluative user research to define problems and validate solutions

With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

title: Senior Product Manager
description: About MUBI MUBI is a global streaming service, production company and film distributor dedicated to elevating great cinema. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. We have a team of brilliant, dedicated and passionate people to help bring our mission to life. From London to New York, Istanbul to Paris, and Berlin to Mexico - we work together to realize MUBI’s vision. That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere. About the role This is a senior, hands-on product role for someone who wants to own a meaningful slice of the MUBI product end-to-end, and is at their best when the problem is still ambiguous. You’ll own the Audience & Platform Expansion domain - a critical product surface for our next phase of growth. In this role, you will be responsible for building the scalable foundation to drive global subscriber acquisition and pioneer our tiered premium offerings. You’ll own its strategy, its roadmap and its delivery, from a high-level business goal all the way to a shipped, measured feature. The hardest product problems at MUBI cross team and time-zone boundaries, and break down without someone holding the whole picture; this role exists to be that person for one of these domains. Reporting to our Senior Product Director, this is a senior, individual contributor role. You'll lead through clarity and influence rather than headcount - aligning engineering, design and data scientists around a vision they actually believe in, and mentoring/coaching other, more junior PMs as you go. We care about craft, in the films we champion and in the products we build, so the bar is product excellence and real user impact, not shipping for its own sake. We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 office days in Soho, London (if you're in commutable distance from London). Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish. Where you'll have impact You'll own a product surface that leadership relies on, translating ambiguous, evolving priorities into a roadmap teams can execute against - and giving the business a crisp, honest read on what's working, what isn't, and what needs a decision. As you build credibility through delivery, you'll set the standard for how product strategy is articulated and defended at MUBI. Concretely, you'll: Translate business goals into clear, actionable product roadmaps, and own the sub-strategy for a specific MUBI area (e.g. onboarding, content/catalogue discovery, monetization, or viewer experience). Guide technical products through the entire lifecycle - from conception, through development, into launch - and iterate after. Partner directly with Engineering, UX/UI Design, Data Science, Marketing, Business Development and Legal to define product requirements and resolve trade-offs. Establish the KPIs and OKRs for your area, and use data-backed insight to iterate quickly and demonstrate measurable impact. Pitch roadmaps to senior leadership to guide resource allocation, and align engineering, design and analytics teams without relying on direct hierarchy. Write narrative strategy memos and present complex visions clearly - to senior leadership and engineering teams alike. Mentor other team members and raise the bar for product thinking around you. What you'll bring You've spent significant time shipping complex technical products end to end, and you're happiest owning a problem from the messy, ambiguous start rather than picking up a tidy backlog. You bring structure where there is none - a clear strategy, sharp prioritisation, honest measurement - without becoming a source of process for its own sake. You're technically fluent enough to hold your own with strong engineers: you can translate an ML model, a streaming architecture or a latency constraint into a business trade-off a stakeholder can act on, and tell a real architectural limit from a convenient one. You're an excellent communicator who can flex between an engineer and an executive in the same hour, equally comfortable writing a strategy memo and defending it in a leadership review. You lead through influence - aligning people across functions, regions and time zones around work they want to do. Qualifications & Expectations Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Design, or equivalent practical experience. 8+ years in product management or a closely related technical role, with at least 3–5 years focused on shipping complex technical products from 0 to 1. Strong business judgment and strategic thinking - able to see the big picture and make connections across teams and issues. Technical acumen: the ability to translate highly technical engineering constraints (machine learning models, streaming architectures, latency) into clear business trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders. Deep domain fluency in identity and access management, subscription management, billing and monetization, and data processing - with the ability to debate architectural and technical trade-offs. A proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through influence rather than direct authority. Exceptional written and verbal communication, including narrative strategy writing for senior audiences. Strong problem-solving, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Experience with AI tools, and AI prototyping A deep alignment with MUBI's culture and values: craftsmanship, product excellence, a bias toward high-impact work, and genuine respect for the user. We want to make cinema accessible to everyone. We believe people from different backgrounds bring different ideas that foster innovation and engagement, allowing us to attract great people to develop the best experience for our users. MUBI is committed to being an Equal Opportunity Employer. That means it's our responsibility to ensure that all candidates are not discriminated against in our hiring processes and our employment decisions based on their race, color, religion, nationality or ethnic origin, age, gender identity or expression, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, socioeconomic background, sexual orientation, family or parental status, or any other applicable characteristic. Where you'll have impact

You'll own a product surface that leadership relies on, translating ambiguous, evolving priorities into a roadmap teams can execute against - and giving the business a crisp, honest read on what's working, what isn't, and what needs a decision. As you build credibility through delivery, you'll set the standard for how product strategy is articulated and defended at MUBI. Concretely, you'll:

  • Partner directly with Engineering, UX/UI Design, Data Science, Marketing, Business Development and Legal to define product requirements and resolve trade-offs.

  • Pitch roadmaps to senior leadership to guide resource allocation, and align engineering, design and analytics teams without relying on direct hierarchy.

  • Write narrative strategy memos and present complex visions clearly - to senior leadership and engineering teams alike.

  • Mentor other team members and raise the bar for product thinking around you.

What you'll bring

  • You've spent significant time shipping complex technical products end to end, and you're happiest owning a problem from the messy, ambiguous start rather than picking up a tidy backlog. You bring structure where there is none - a clear strategy, sharp prioritisation, honest measurement - without becoming a source of process for its own sake.

  • You're technically fluent enough to hold your own with strong engineers: you can translate an ML model, a streaming architecture or a latency constraint into a business trade-off a stakeholder can act on, and tell a real architectural limit from a convenient one.

Given the novelty of Lila’s workflows, integrating frontier-class language models with narrow scientific tools and lab-based automation, this role will require the design and deployment of technical safeguards beyond the current state-of-the-art.</p> <p>We expect the person in this role to start off the initial mitigations build-out, and then slowly build a team to support this function.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Be Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set the build and research strategy for Lila’s safety systems, across scientific data analysis and generation pipelines, safety post-training, refusal classifiers, automated safety-testing / red-teaming systems, and monitoring systems.</li> <li>Conduct initial safeguards experimentation and buildout for Lila’s specific scientific needs, and subsequently lead a small team to execute on the build and research agenda</li> <li>Lead safety systems research to iterate Lila’s systems beyond the state of the art, given the needs of technical safeguards for both in silico and lab-based scientific workflows.</li> <li>Partner closely with <ul> <li>Other members of the safety team, such as domain-specific experts (bio, chem, materials) and eval buildout teams, and</li> <li>Non-safety teams, such as core AI, lab automation, and product teams,</li> </ul> </li> <li>Contributing to broader, high-quality research efforts - as and when needed - for scientific capability evaluation and restriction.</li> <li>Contribute to external communications on Lila’s safety efforts.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Need to Succeed</strong></p> <ul> <li>Track record of building safety systems, classifiers, or conducting post-training for frontier-class problems - The Middle East and North Africa (MENA) is a core region for ExTrac's intelligence coverage, spanning the political and security dynamics, actors, movements, and online ecosystems that shape risk across the region and beyond it. We are the analytical backbone for decision-making when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai . The Role As a Senior Analyst covering the MENA region, you will help ExTrac understand and anticipate political and security developments across the region, including the activities of state and non-state actors, violent extremist organisations (VEOs), and the online ecosystems in which they operate. Working in Arabic every day, across standard and dialectal material, you will turn what you find into timely reporting that feeds ExTrac's intelligence products and data platform. What the job involves Intelligence collection and analysis Monitor and assess political, security, and socio-economic developments across MENA, including regional diplomacy, state and non-state actors, and geopolitical risk, with the ability to contribute to wider global coverage when required. Conduct daily monitoring of Arabic- and English-language media, including news outlets, social media platforms, official statements, and other open-source information environments. Track VEO and non-state armed group activity, including organisational developments, propaganda and communications activity, governance dynamics, operational activity, and regional linkages. Identify new narratives, actors, platforms, and threats appearing across online ecosystems. Apply structured analytical techniques to assess complex information and identify patterns and relationships. Intelligence production Lead and contribute to daily, weekly, monthly, flash, and deep-dive analytical reporting, with a particular focus on MENA and VEOs. Translate and assess Arabic-language documents and other source material. Contribute to client-facing discussions, briefings, and ad hoc research requests as required. Develop and maintain subject-matter expertise across designated countries, actors, organisations, and thematic areas. Data curation Lead and contribute to source coverage for the region, identifying and proposing new actors, entities, channels, and outlets for inclusion in ExTrac's research ecosystem. Verify and assess sources in the original language prior to inclusion. Maintain coverage against intelligence requirements, identifying where it should expand or deepen. Contribute to the taxonomy and tagging decisions that structure MENA and violent extremism data. Work with the wider research and data teams to translate analytical judgement into structured data that others can rely on without further verification. Leadership and collaboration Support the Team Lead with the reviewing, and quality assurance of analytical outputs. Mentor junior analysts on research methodology, analytical standards, and source validation. Support other teams across ExTrac on projects and deliverables when required. Innovation and capability development Help develop research methodologies, monitoring frameworks, and analytical processes to improve team efficiency and product quality. Integrate AI systems and AI-assisted workflows into analytical practice where they create genuine improvements. You should apply if MENA is the region you already follow closely, across its politics, security dynamics, and the violent extremist movements and online ecosystems operating within it. This is the region you want to go deeper on rather than a rotation on the way to something else. You work in Arabic, not just alongside it. You read Modern Standard Arabic and dialect comfortably, you notice when slang is doing something new, and you can tell the difference between a shift in language and a shift in intent. Writing is one of your strengths. You can turn a fast-moving, ambiguous picture into a concise, evidence-based assessment under deadline, and you take pride in doing it well. You care about the quality of the underlying data as much as the quality of the analysis built on it, and you hold both to the same standard. You want to keep producing analysis at volume and take on more alongside it. Reviewing others' work, helping set priorities for a small team, and mentoring junior analysts appeal to you as additions to the writing, not a step away from it. You thrive on operational tempo. Daily and flash reporting alongside longer deep dives suits how you like to work, and the pace energises rather than drains you. You are already using AI in your workflow and are interested in what it changes about analytical craft. Build leadership experience through mentoring junior analysts, quality-assuring their work, and supporting prioritisation across a small team. Support the development of the monitoring frameworks and analytical methodologies used across the team. Shape how AI changes intelligence work itself, championing new tools and methodologies across the Research & Analysis team and influencing how the whole function operates. Requirements At least five years of professional experience in intelligence analysis, geopolitical risk, disinformation analysis, strategic communications, international security, international relations, or a related field. Strong subject-matter knowledge of the MENA region, including its key political and security actors and regional dynamics. A working understanding of VEOs, their online ecosystems, communications strategies, narratives, and operational activity, built through direct analytical experience. Fluency in written Arabic, across both Modern Standard Arabic and local dialects, including knowledge of slang, with the ability to monitor, analyse, and translate Arabic-language content from a range of sources. Demonstrable experience applying structured analytical methodologies to complex information environments and online ecosystems, including OSINT, network analysis, narrative analysis, sentiment analysis, or other quantitative and qualitative approaches. Strong written communication skills, with a track record of producing concise, high-quality, policy-relevant intelligence and analytical outputs under tight deadlines. Hands-on experience curating source coverage: identifying and verifying online sources, assessing their affiliation, and maintaining structured datasets to a defined standard. Experience proofreading, editing, and quality-assuring analytical products. Strong organisational skills and the ability to work independently while managing multiple concurrent workstreams and competing priorities. Strong attention to detail and the ability to distinguish meaningful developments from high-volume information flows. Able to communicate complex political, security, and extremist-related developments clearly to both specialist and non-specialist audiences. Comfortable integrating AI systems into your workflow to improve outputs and efficiency. A strong understanding of the legal and ethical considerations surrounding intelligence collection, open-source research, and data handling, including responsible use of publicly available information. raw.description:
About ThriveCart:

ThriveCart is a powerful platform used by over 50,000 people worldwide to generate over $5B in sales. Included within the ThriveCart platform is a learning management system (LMS), affiliate management, cart and checkout functionality, making it a top solution for creators, coaches, consultants, and other businesses.

We integrate with everything you use and have a simple, clean UI with numerous features that allow customers to build income from existing traffic and we are the highest-converting cart for online businesses. Our business is growing, profitable, and backed by LTV SaaS Growth Funds, and we are looking to expand our footprint amongst online businesses.

Location:

Remote (Europe / LATAM)

Job Overview:

Full-ownership software engineer responsible for building a new system in TypeScript that will replace our existing PHP system, while maintaining the current PHP system throughout the transition. This is not a hand-off role — you take a problem from requirement to production and own it there. You'll work across both stacks, make technical decisions, and be accountable for what you ship.

We expect you to use AI coding tools as a core part of how you work. Not occasionally — daily. Your velocity, code quality, and problem-solving should reflect effective AI tool use. What we care about is judgment: understanding what you ship, making the right decisions, and knowing when to push back on AI output.

This description applies across experience levels (L1–L4). Interview depth and expectations are calibrated to your level.

Tasks

What You'll Own:

  • Features from requirements to production: you break them down, build them, ship them, monitor them
  • Technical decisions within your scope, with clear trade-off reasoning
  • Quality of your code and the areas you touch
  • Responding to incidents and dev-escalations in your domain
  • Building the new TypeScript system that will replace the legacy PHP platform
  • Maintaining and supporting the existing PHP system throughout the transition

What Your Work Will Entail:

1. Feature Development

  • Take feature requests, break them into tasks, estimate, and deliver independently
  • Build the new TypeScript-based system designed to replace our existing PHP platform
  • Maintain and support the current PHP system in parallel, until the new system is fully migrated
  • Write clean, tested, production-ready code that meets team standards
  • Make technical decisions for features and explain trade-offs clearly
  • Monitor your features in production — logs, metrics, alerts
  • Leave the codebase better than you found it (refactor, document, reduce debt)

2. Production Ownership & Incident Response

  • Respond to dev-escalations with urgency — investigate issues, communicate findings, contribute to resolution
  • Participate in incident response: at all levels, you are expected to show up, help investigate, and support resolution
  • L4+: Drive incident response for your domain — coordinate investigation, delegate tasks, communicate status to stakeholders, and ensure post-mortems happen
  • Write runbooks and keep documentation current as you build
  • Share on-call rotation after ramp-up period

3. Code Quality & Testing

  • Write unit and integration tests as part of feature work, not as an afterthought
  • Participate actively in code reviews — give thoughtful feedback, act on feedback you receive
  • Identify edge cases and risks during planning, not after deployment

4. AI-Augmented Development (Expected, Not Optional)

  • Use AI coding tools daily: code generation, debugging, test writing, exploring unfamiliar parts of the codebase, code review acceleration
  • Your output should be measurably faster because of AI tools
  • You understand everything you ship — AI is an accelerator, not a replacement for judgment
  • L3+: Help teammates develop effective AI workflows; contribute to team standards for AI tool use
  • L4+: Set team standards for AI tool usage — evaluate what delivers real value, ensure quality isn't sacrificed for speed

5. Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product, Design, QA, and other engineers
  • Contribute meaningfully to sprint planning and technical discussions
  • L3+: Mentor L1/L2 engineers through code reviews, pairing, and sharing knowledge

Requirements

What You Bring To This Role:

Technical Environment

  • Primary stack: TypeScript/Node.js for the new system you'll build, and PHP 7.4/8+ with Laravel for the existing system you'll maintain during the transition.
  • Infrastructure: MariaDB, Redis, AWS (EC2, RDS, CloudWatch, SQS, S3), Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD

This role requires active, hands-on TypeScript experience and past professional experience with PHP. Hands-on experience integrating payment platforms such as Stripe and PayPal is required.

Expectations by Level:

  • L1: Works on well-scoped tickets with guidance. Learning the codebase and practices. Uses AI tools to learn faster and ship more.
  • L2: Independently owns features. Minimal guidance needed on implementation. Noticeably faster because of AI tool usage.
  • L3: Leads small projects. Mentors L1/L2. Improves the codebase proactively. Teaches effective AI workflows.
  • L4: Technical authority for a domain. Drives cross-team projects. Sets team AI standards. Drives incident response.

Success Metrics:

Early on, you'll ship your first feature to production, understand the core architecture, and get your local development environment set up. From there, you'll be independently shipping features end-to-end and contributing to code reviews. As you grow further, you'll contribute meaningfully to technical discussions and handle dev-escalations in your area.

On-Call:

Shared rotation (~1 week/month after ramp-up). Critical: 15 min. High: 1 hour.

Think about this role as some combination of incident responder, detection engineer, security engineer, SOC automation engineer, threat hunter, threat modeler, and security awareness engineer. Our SOC team is involved in engineering (e.g., we built our own SOAR, email content scanning system, the entire alerting stack and much more) and we handle the incident response and remediation when a threat is found.</p> <p>Our analysts research and prioritise what threats need to be monitored, hunt for them in our data, write code to detect them and constantly tune the detection to prioritise quality over quantity. We maintain full control over the alerts we respond to, and own all stages of the detection and response lifecycle.</p> <p>Our Cybersecurity team is a skilled group of programmers and security experts who are dedicated to keeping the firm safe. raw.title: Claims Validation Handler
raw.description:
We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

The Claims Validation Team
The Claims Validation Team exists to help to defend Marshmallow against fraudulent activity, and to protect the company loss ratio. Fraudulent claims can result in us losing money, which can then result in driving up the premium prices for our honest customers. We’re here to stop that, by making sure that the right claims are reviewed for any policyholder or indemnity related concerns.


What you’ll be doing

  • Reviewing indemnity referrals flagged by our wider claims team, where it has been identified at the point of claim that customers have misrepresented their policy details, and deciding upon the appropriate course of action for the policy and claim

  • Investigating first party claims by communicating with our policyholders by phone and email and conducting follow up investigations

  • Working proactively and efficiently to minimise leakage

  • Contacting customers regarding document requests or any necessary changes to their policy, and providing excellent customer service

  • Collaborating and building strong relationships with both the wider claims and fraud teams

  • Proactively identifying opportunities to improve our processes to help us to protect both the company loss ratio, and our honest customers

Who you are

  • You have an investigative mindset with strong attention to detail and accuracy

  • You are confident in good decision making, and can work efficiently under pressure

  • You have strong communication skills and are comfortable in liaising with other teams from across the business

  • You enjoy working in a high growth environment and are adaptable to change and balancing conflicting priorities

  • You are a self-starter who likes to take ownership

  • You take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience and enjoy interacting with our customers

  • You are tenacious and persistent; knowing when further investigation can lead to positive commercial outcomes for the business

What we're looking for from you

  • A background in fraud or claims/policy validation

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to be able to effectively communicate with our customers

  • You are really passionate about the customer, and will go the extra mile to offer them the best service

  • Working in a fast-paced scale up means that you have to be adaptable and excited by the prospect of moving fast

  • You enjoy finding solutions to problems you come across rather than waiting on others to do this for you

  • You enjoy taking ownership of your own workload, and proactively highlight any blockers that you or your team may be facing

Perks of the job

  • Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance

  • Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva

  • Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year

  • Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

Our process

We break it up into a few stages:

  • Initial call with someone in our Talent Team (30 mins)

  • A skill-based interview where you will discuss your previous experience also with a focus on our values, our culture and your motivations with our Claims Validation Team Lead plus one other team member (1 hour)

We’ll let you know if you’re invited to an interview or not. But, as a small team with a lot of applications to consider, we can’t give personal feedback on each application.

#LI-PT1

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

Strong understanding of software architecture, algorithms, object-oriented programming, functional design principles, APIs, and integration patterns. Practical knowledge of LLM application development, including prompt engineering, context management, tokens, embeddings, vector search, RAG, tool use, structured outputs, and model evaluation. Strong architectural thinking, analytical ability, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail. Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to collaborate across client, consulting, engineering, product, data, and AI/ML teams. raw.description:
About MoonPay

MoonPay is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents.

Recent recognition:


Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 .
2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100
The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running

Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot.


About the Opportunity

In this role, you will join MoonPay’s Crypto Asset Management team as a Product Manager, helping us build and scale the liquidity and asset infrastructure that supports products across MoonPay.

The team is responsible for how liquidity is sourced and distributed across our platform, supporting high-value crypto transaction volumes across multiple assets, venues, and blockchains. As our remit expands across products including Ramps, Swaps, and Enterprise, the volume and complexity of product work is growing with it.

You will take ownership of day-to-day product execution across our on-chain and off-chain workstreams, helping turn business and technical requirements into clearly defined, prioritised, and executable work.

Working closely with the Principal Product Manager, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, and commercial teams, you will support initiatives including liquidity-provider integrations, asset availability, routing and best-execution capabilities, custody and wallet infrastructure, and the broader on-chain services required to operate reliably at scale.

Your work will help the team move faster, improve the efficiency and resilience of our liquidity infrastructure, and enable MoonPay to support significantly more products and transaction volume as the business grows.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, wants to deepen their understanding of crypto and financial infrastructure, and is excited to develop their product craft in a fast-moving, high-impact environment.

What You Will Do

  • Own day-to-day product execution across Crypto Asset Management initiatives, translating business, technical, operational, and compliance requirements into clear product requirements, user stories, project plans, and delivery milestones.

  • Support integrations with new liquidity sources, including centralised exchanges, OTC trading desks, and decentralised services, helping expand MoonPay’s liquidity network and improve sourcing efficiency, reliability, and execution.

  • Coordinate asset availability and infrastructure initiatives across Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, Commercial, and other Product teams, ensuring dependencies, decisions, risks, and requirements are understood and tracked through delivery.

  • Support the setup and evolution of technical infrastructure across areas such as wallets, gas sponsorship, transaction broadcasting, and other on-chain infrastructure services, working closely with engineering and operational teams to translate requirements into scalable product solutions.

  • Support roadmap development and prioritisation, using data, commercial value, operational requirements, customer impact, risk, and engineering constraints to help determine which initiatives should be addressed first.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our liquidity and asset-management infrastructure, including custody and wallet capabilities, liquidity routing, best execution, settlement efficiency, monitoring, and risk-management tooling.

  • Use data to evaluate product performance and opportunities, identifying friction, operational inefficiencies, or areas where product and infrastructure improvements can create measurable value for MoonPay and its customers.

 

 

About You

Must-have experience and skills

  • You have experience working in product management, product operations, treasury, finance, business analysis, technical programme delivery, or a similar role, and can take a problem from initial requirements through to structured execution.

  • You are comfortable working across cross-functional teams, particularly with Engineering, Operations, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, or Commercial stakeholders, and can turn complex or ambiguous requirements into clear actions and priorities.

  • You have strong product thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to understand trade-offs, use data to support decisions, and prioritise work based on business and customer impact.

  • You have a genuine interest in crypto, fintech, or financial infrastructure and are motivated to build a deeper understanding of areas such as blockchain networks, liquidity, exchanges, custody, wallets, and digital-asset infrastructure.

Nice-to-have experience

  • Previous exposure to crypto or fintech infrastructure, particularly liquidity management, exchange or OTC integrations, stablecoins, custody, wallets, or DeFi protocols.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with regulated financial products, crypto compliance requirements, blockchain infrastructure, or products handling high-value financial transactions.

Benefits & Perks 💡

  • 💰 Competitive salary package

  • 🤝 Equity package: financial freedom starts with our employees, so all employees have ownership at MoonPay

  • 📈 Pay-for-performance equity bonus: those who drive outsized outcomes receive outsized rewards

  • 🚀 Moonshot award: we honor exceptional impact. 10 employees twice a year, each earning a $250,000 equity grant

  • 📊Pension: employer contributions from day one

  • 🎁Employee referral program: refer great people, earn 10K in USDC

  • 🏝 Flexible Time Off: choose when to work and when to switch off

  • 🎂 Birthday leave: take the day off to celebrate you

  • 🍼 Enhanced parental leave: more time with family, no second thought

  • 🌍 Hybrid working schedule: work fully remotely or from your nearest Moonbase

  • 🚆 Commuter benefits: public transport to and from the office

  • 🩺 Private healthcare benefits: to protect you and your loved ones

  • 🧘 Wellhub wellness membership: access to gyms, studios, classes, and wellness apps in one membership

  • 🤖 Unlimited enterprise access to the latest AI tools: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and whatever's next

  • 🍱 Lunch credit: meals covered on the days you're in the office

  • 🪑 Home office setup allowance: build the home office of your dreams

  • 👛 Remote working allowance: those working fully remotely get a little extra for utilities

  • 🌕 Monthly product budget and zero-fee crypto transactions

  • 📚 $1,000 Annual training budget: we support your learning journey

  • 🎯 High Potential Program: structured development, mentorship, and stretch opportunities

  • ✈️ Regular remote company offsites: high-impact in-person sessions and hackathons

  • 🚲 (Ireland) Cycle to Work scheme: tax-efficient bike, gear, and safety kit

  • 🔌 (UK) EV Salary Sacrifice: lease an electric vehicle through pre-tax salary
